scope: Complete pre-publication tracing for the current v5 evidence asset and explicitly pin remaining historical source-test fixtures; no product or permission delta.
riskAnalysis: One customer JavaScript line changes optional request membership only. Supporting historical source/copy/admission changes are security-sensitive: never substitute old evidence for current source, weaken permissions, rewrite receipts or revive grants. Current-source product tests and explicitly historical regression fixtures are separate.

threatModel.assets: Product entitlement behavior, backend authorization, original source/receipt integrity, task/release binding and audit history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Model-authored line was independently inspected before Work source application. Current source lock and frozen historical source are distinct. Only Work controls publication; internal agents remain proposal-only.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale source promoted as current, historical task readback reused as fresh authority, forged patch binding, arbitrary old preimage, cross-workspace change, hidden real plan mutation in QA, false acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact original file and five receipt hashes, one unique replacement, current-only source/task guard, explicit task retirement, immutable asset hash check for historical copies, unchanged bounded patch grammar/authorization/cancellation, separate current-product tests, fictional restored browser state and no provider writes.

defects.historicalPrevention: Never rewrite old source or weaken current guards to satisfy historical fixtures; explicit tracing is required before any source Preview.
